title: Nik's Craftables - Dyes
description: Adds more crafting recipes for dyes. For when deserts are too far away and flowers are too pretty to discard.
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds more crafting recipes for dyes. Made for builders who need a _lot_ of dye and don't want to use their precious flowers. Also adds the missing dye mix for green dye.

## Knowledge Book Recipe
![crafting recipe for knowledge book, which is crafted with one book and one emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5b4a77a1353c0362196fcd23e7dbaea1fb016e.png)
